name: Believer
description: A believer is a member of an organised religion or belief system who has made their faith the centre of their life and work.

mainstream_believer.name: Mainstream Believer
mainstream_believer.description: Serve within the mainstream hierarchy of your faith.

missionary_humanitarian.name: Missionary/Humanitarian
missionary_humanitarian.description: Spread your faith or provide aid in the wider world.

mishaps.1: Injured in a conflict or persecuted for your faith. Roll on the Injury table and leave this career.
mishaps.2: Someone offended by your belief system bears a grudge. Gain an Enemy.
mishaps.3: You are demoted for failing your superiors. Lose one rank and forfeit this term's Benefit roll, but you do not have to leave this career.
mishaps.4: A doctrinal dispute causes you to doubt or revise your beliefs. Lose 1 level in Profession (Religion) or Science (Belief) but you do not have to leave this career.
mishaps.5: Your faith is tested and you are found wanting. Lose all Benefit rolls gained thus far in this career, but you do not have to leave this career.
mishaps.6: A splinter group within your faith turns against you. Gain D3 Rivals.

events.2: Disaster! Roll on the Mishap table but you are not ejected from this career.
events.3: Your faith wins you powerful friends in the community. Gain SOC +1 and an Ally.
events.4: You come into contact with an academic interested in your belief system. Gain a Contact.
events.5: Your faith drives you to engage with the wider world. Gain one level of Streetwise or Persuade.
events.6: You retreat from worldly concerns to deepen your faith. Lose SOC D3 but gain D3 Benefit rolls and DM+1 on all future Benefit rolls.
events.7: Life Event. Roll on the Life Events table.
events.8: You work to build your congregation or community. Gain one level of Carouse or Persuade.
events.9: You are offered substantial inducements to betray your faith. If you betray it, leave this career and lose all Benefit rolls accumulated, but gain Cr2D×10,000 for each Benefit roll lost. If you stay loyal, gain 1D Enemies.
events.10: You are asked to secretly provide last rites for a dying member of the nobility who is not of your faith. If you agree, gain an Ally in their household but also a Rival within your own faith community. If you refuse, there is no effect.
events.11: Your superiors find fault with you and your dedication to doctrine is questioned. Permanent DM-2 on all future Advancement rolls in this career.
events.12: You are recognized as a shining example of your faith. You are automatically promoted and gain a permanent DM+1 on all future Advancement rolls in this career.

1.benefit: The knowledge that your soul is saved

6.benefit: You will be rewarded in the next life
